_comment: UK region pack: first pack, used for prototyping. The core must not assume any of these values.
_headroom_reserved: RESERVED: read into RegionPack::headroom_m but nothing uses it yet (minimum bridge soffit clearance over a road, for the future structure clearance checks)
_headroom_source: UK standard headroom 5.03 m plus allowance; tune by eye

render._comment: Cross-section shape for road types that leave crossfall / kerb_upstand_m / footway_crossfall / verge_crossfall unset (rise over run, m).

grading._comment: Ground grading and earthwork limits (cp::GradingRules); tuned by eye in the road-draw prototype. wall_cap_m is also the height above which the road must be a bridge or tunnel.

structures._comment: Structure dimensions (cp::StructureRules); engineering defaults tuned by eye.

roundabout._comment: Roundabout tool and layout tunables; tuned by eye. Roundabout-ness itself comes from the roundabout_ring flag on a road type.
roundabout._size_classes: estimate (UK roundabout practice, DMRB CD 116 style values recalled, not checked): by ring centreline radius. Entry fillets are tight (slow entries), exit fillets generous (easy exits); the splitter island widens toward the ring, its length scaled by the approach speed; small rings get an over-run apron.

junction._comment: Junction shaping defaults. All numbers are estimates (UK practice recalled, not checked), tuned by eye; a player override always wins.
junction._corner_radius_by_class: Default kerb radius by the pair of road classes meeting (minor = the less important arm): lane 30, residential 50, ring 60 / rural B 60, B 70, main street 75, rural A 90, dual 100. First match wins; no match = the larger road-type corner_radius_m.

merge._comment: Merge / diverge geometry. taper_length: odd arm trim by the main carriageway design speed (75 m up to 80 km/h, 110 m up to 100 dual, else 150 motorway); gore_length_m: gore triangle beyond the nose point. Estimates, tuned by eye.

turn_pockets._comment: Ghost-island offside-turn lanes. Default on where the through road is rural A class or above and the minor road is a lesser road leaving it at roughly a right angle; none on residential or town streets. Taper 1:N and pocket lane length by the through road speed limit: estimate (TD 42 style, recalled, not checked).
